verdict.rationale: Airbyte documents a public API to programmatically control Cloud, OSS and Enterprise, with a published OpenAPI spec and a live Try It console. It also offers a Terraform provider for configuration as code, PyAirbyte for running extract-and-load in Python, and abctl as a CLI to create and manage instances, so headless configuration and operation through API, CLI or code is clearly supported. However, connector scaffolding is documented only through the UI-based Connector Builder and its AI Assistant, and the evidence does not show agent-driven end-to-end pipeline creation and sync triggering. Missing for 10: headless/CLI connector scaffolding, explicit evidence of creating connections and triggering syncs via API, and hands-on corroboration of a coding agent running a complete pipeline end to end.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, a coding agent can scaffold, configure, and run a complete pipeline headlessly through the CLI or API

citations.quote: Use the Airbyte API to programmatically interact with Airbyte. For example, you can control Airbyte in conjunction with orchestration tools like Airflow.
you can use Airbyte's Terraform provider to automate and version control your Airbyte configuration as code
Data can be extracted from sources and loaded into caches
abctl is Airbyte's open source command line tool to create and manage local instances of Airbyte running in Docker.
Programmatically control Airbyte Cloud, OSS & Enterprise.
